theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Oil Jumps on Iran Attack, Asian Stocks Set to Drop: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Oil surged as the US military said it was carrying out new strikes against Iran. Stocks in Asia were poised to drop for a second day as a selloff in chipmakers rippled across markets.

top_news.title: Oil Surges as US Strikes Targets in Iran Following Ship Attacks
top_news.summary: Oil jumped — after gaining almost 3% on Tuesday — as the US launched a wave of strikes against Iran in retaliation for a spate of attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Exxon Sees $3.7 Billion Profit Surge From War-Driven Oil Rally
top_news.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. said second-quarter earnings jumped by almost $4 billion as the Iran conflict boosted oil prices.

top_news.title: US Judge Rejects DOJ Subpoena Over 2020 Georgia Election
top_news.summary: A federal judge rejected an effort by the US Justice Department to obtain information on election workers in Fulton County, Georgia, related to the 2020 vote.

top_news.title: Amazon’s New Bonds Get Cooler Reception as AI Debt Floods Market
top_news.summary: When Amazon.com Inc. sold its biggest ever bond earlier this year, it was inundated with investor orders amid hype about the artificial intelligence boom. This time around there’s less fanfare.

top_news.title: Allstate Sued by Oklahoma for Alleged Scheme to Underpay Claims
top_news.summary: Oklahoma’s attorney general sued Allstate Corp., alleging the insurer schemed to minimize payouts to homeowners for wind and hailstorm damage in order to boost its profits.

top_news.title: Tech Rout Deepens as Chipmakers Fall; SpaceX Gets Bullish Calls
top_news.summary: US technology shares declined on Tuesday after earnings from Samsung Electronics Co. failed to satisfy investors, spurring worries over the durability of this year’s red-hot artificial intelligence trade.

top_news.title: Chip Stocks Sink After Blistering Run as Oil Jumps: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Wall Street was rattled by a selloff in chipmakers on concerns over whether massive artificial-intelligence investments will justify lofty valuations while a jump in oil prices boosted bond yields.

top_news.title: Traders Hedge for Less Hawkish Fed as Hikes Remain Priced In
top_news.summary: Options traders are increasing bets that the broader market is overestimating how much the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates this year.

top_news.title: Volatility in Chip Sector Continues | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Katie Greifeld, Carol Massar and Emily Graffeo. (Source: Bloomberg)
